goal: Allow running txindex on pruned nodes without storing the entire blockchain on disk
Return candidate block hashes on pruned lookups so callers can fetch missing blocks on demand via RPC
agreement: Strong support for making pruned nodes significantly more capable (ajtowns, arejula27, l0rinc, optout21)
Verified by testing reindexing on a pruned node and querying recent and old transactions (optout21)
Minor questions on edge case error reporting and synced checks remain open (arejula27, fjahr)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it allows txindex on pruned nodes, resolving long-standing user requests dating back to 2017
Pruned node operators can locate any historical transaction without storing full block files on disk

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because RPC and REST errors return candidate block hashes when transaction data has been pruned
Enables automated callers to fetch missing blocks on demand via getblockfrompeer
